notes.title: Behind the Scenes
notes.notes: [p]🎨 We love keeping things handcrafted! For our in-game icons, we turned to traditional watercolor painting. [/p][p]Each icon was painted by hand, giving them a unique, organic texture that feels alive in the world of our game. [/p][p]🌿 It was such a joy experimenting, splattering, and layering colors, and we hope that when you discover these little works of art in-game, you’ll feel some of the same joy we had while creating them. ✨[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45687250/b31cbc9839ed38c634014bb816103a79f9e99eab.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45687250/7b2dd8d9d5af7610de85e8fe5315848a948a04b7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45687250/011fcbcb831bdb23bf7206e2f2fef8bdf9ffa60c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45687250/207c71a4f4a472b79840b81e8fbfe49fa9244137.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Behind the Scenes
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone! We thought we'd continue to share some of the behind the scenes content to show you how we are progressing, and how we're building the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Over on our social channels there are already videos on how we built the movement for Boris, the scent mechanic and how we're animating him.[/p][p]We shared some of the process for developing the look of the game, with a realistic yet authored feel. We would like the forest to 'feel' like the forests we visited, rather than look exactly like it.[/p][p]And today we have a more technical look at how we're building a particular asset: the dandelion.[/p][p][/p][p]We like the environment to feel alive, like you can almost touch it. Well, you can touch it through Boris of course. So when he moves through the world, it responds and creates wonderful moments like the dandelions taking off.[/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/shorts/HeEOggvmICY"]How to build dandelions in Blender \[Behind the scenes] #gamedev #indiedev #trailertuesday #flowers[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope you appreciate this little look behind the scenes, and stay tuned for more![/p][p][/p][p]- Wild Sheep studio team[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 20,000 Wishlists in 4 Weeks
notes.notes: [p]In just 4 weeks since we announced Adorable Adventures we have reached 20.000 wishlists (and counting).[/p][p][/p][p]Wishlists helps us reach more players on Steam, so every single one makes a big difference.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for the amazing support, it truly means the world to us![/p][p][/p][p]We've got plenty more cuteness and chaos coming your way soon. Stay tuned, the adorable adventures are just getting started![/p][p][/p][p]- Wild Sheep Studio team[/p]

notes.title: New game details revealed
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45687250/3f74948a6df99cc3aa9be5b6c4939fb70dcaf1e6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We were fortunate to sit down with Jason from So Many Games and discuss Adorable Adventures. [/p][p]He asked us many interesting questions, from how we are developing the game, to how the mechanics actually work and what the ideas are behind the game.[/p][p]So we are happy to share this interview, and hopefully you see some new details about the game that excite you![/p][p][url="https://somanygames.co.uk/articles/adorable-adventures-interview/"]Adorable Adventures with Steven ter Heide | So Many Games[/url][/p]

notes.title: Highlands environment reveal
notes.notes: [p]Inspired by a nearby national park, we are creating a variety of environments that Boris will explore.[/p][p]After the forest from the announce trailer, we are now showing off the highlands. [/p][p]Besides using his nose, Boris is always looking for fun activities and toys to play with even when sometimes they are just out his reach. He will scramble to get there.[/p][p]A new trailer and some new screenshots are available on the store page now.[/p][p]We hope you enjoy this little update, and continue to look forward to the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Merci,[/p][p]Wild Sheep Studio team[/p][p][/p][p][/p]
